gloss: Central and South America; Latin America

definitions.gloss: Central and South America; Latin America
definitions.explanation: A geographic term covering the regions of Central America and South America combined. Often used loosely as equivalent to Latin America in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {中南米|ちゅうなんべい}を{旅行|りょこう}した。
examples.english: I traveled through Central and South America.

examples.japanese: {中南米|ちゅうなんべい}ではスペイン{語|ご}が{広|ひろ}く{話|はな}されている。
examples.english: Spanish is widely spoken in Central and South America.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}から{中南米|ちゅうなんべい}への{移民|いみん}は{明治時代|めいじじだい}に{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Japanese emigration to Central and South America began in the Meiji period.

notes: Abbreviation of {中央|ちゅうおう}アメリカ (Central America) + {南|みなみ}アメリカ (South America). Japan has significant historical ties to {中南米|ちゅうなんべい} through emigration, especially to Brazil and Peru. Related geographic terms: {北米|ほくべい} (North America), {南米|なんべい} (South America), {中米|ちゅうべい} (Central America). Also sometimes referred to as ラテンアメリカ (Latin America).
